## Description

Deploys MADDPG agents across fragmented exchange venues to coordinate order splitting and route execution parcels simultaneously, minimizing market impact and adverse selection.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional block trades, fragmented liquidity venues (crypto or equities), multi-exchange execution.

## Vehicles

Agency Execution Desks, Algorithmic Execution Brokers, Prop Trading Firms.

## Required data

Level 2/3 order book feeds across multiple venues, historical volume profiles, execution fill logs.

## Caveats

Multi-agent training non-stationarity requires centralized critic evaluation and robust reward shaping.
